summary: Jianzhi Education Technology Group Co Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing the appointment of Mr. Xiaohui Li as co-executive officer, effective September 1, 2026. The filing includes Mr. Li's professional background and forward-looking statements. This is a routine management appointment announcement with no special-situation implications, such as a forced departure or strategic event. The filing does not involve any transaction, offer, or corporate action. Accordingly, it is categorized as None, as it does not qualify as a special situation under the defined criteria.
